heads.title: Unsubstantiality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes ideas, arguments and objects, though dreamy, vacuous and vacant can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Intrinsicality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mixes inherent-quality words that describe traits (innate, inborn, natural, thoroughbred) with words about things or abstractions (intrinsic, derived from within, inwrought).

heads.title: Extrinsicality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes external or accidental features; only objective and outward could describe a person's outlook.

heads.title: Irrelation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes relations and foreign things, but independent, insular and strange can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Dissimilarity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes differences between things; original and unique can occasionally describe a person's character.

heads.title: Nonimitation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes uniqueness of things, but creative, inventive and original can describe a person's abilities.

heads.title: Quantity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Quantity words (some, any, a few) describe amounts, not people.

heads.title: Mean
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Its adjectives are mostly about averages and intermediate quantities; only "mean" can describe a person (stingy or unkind), and "middle-class" describes a social group a person belongs to.

heads.title: Smallness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes size and degree; sparing could describe a frugal person.

heads.title: Incoherence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes physical looseness or mixing; lax, relaxed and slack can describe a person's habits.

heads.title: Decomposition
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes chemical and analytical processes, not people.

heads.title: Completeness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes completeness of things; thorough-going, unmitigated and consummate can describe a person of a given kind.

heads.title: Exclusion
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes exclusion of things from a set, not a person's character.

heads.title: Order
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Neat, tidy, methodical, systematic and businesslike readily describe a person's habits of conduct.

heads.title: Disorder
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Slovenly, untidy, desultory, unsystematic and aimless describe a person's habits, though many others describe things.

heads.title: Arrangement
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes arrangement of things; methodical and systematic can describe a person's habits.

heads.title: Inclusion
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes inclusion within a whole, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Conformity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes conformity to rules or ordinary occurrence; habitual and normal can describe a person.

heads.title: Unconformity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes departure from norms in things; wanton, lawless, peculiar and aberrant can describe a person.

heads.title: Unity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes number and unity; solitary, lonely, odd and singular can describe a person.

heads.title: Synchronism
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes simultaneity or coexistence in time, not people.

heads.title: Newness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes newness of things, though green, raw and immature can describe an inexperienced person.

heads.title: Oldness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mixed: venerable, primitive and antediluvian can describe a person, but most adjectives describe age or things.

heads.title: Youth
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes age, though callow, juvenile and youthful can describe a person's conduct or temperament.

heads.title: Age
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes age, though mellow, antiquated and passe can describe a person's manner or outlook.

heads.title: Adolescence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes life stage, though mature, manly and womanly can describe a person's character.

heads.title: Permanence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes lasting things, though persistent and conservative can describe a person's disposition.

heads.title: Changeableness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many adjectives describe temperament: fickle, inconstant, restless, erratic, unstable and fitful.

heads.title: Stability
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many adjectives describe a steady character: steadfast, steady, constant, firm and balanced.

heads.title: Chance
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes chance events and things; only casual loosely describes a person's manner.

heads.title: Power
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mixed: capable, able, competent and powerful describe people, while most others describe things or arguments.

heads.title: Impotence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe a person's failings or unfitness: incompetent, inept, incapable, unqualified and harmless.

heads.title: Strength
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many adjectives (strong, vigorous, robust, hardy, powerful, invincible, stout, sturdy) routinely describe a person's constitution or character, so most can describe what someone is like.

heads.title: Weakness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Most describe a person's frailty or temperament: weak, feeble, nervous, soft, effeminate and frail.

heads.title: Destruction
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes destructive events or things, though destructive, subversive and incendiary can describe a person.

heads.title: Agency
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes things in operation, though practical and efficient can describe a person's skills.

heads.title: Physical Energy
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mixed: energetic, active, brisk and keen can describe a person, while most others describe physical force or sensation.

heads.title: Physical Inertness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mixed: sluggish, passive, slow, dull and tame can describe a person, but most describe physical inertness.

heads.title: Violence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe a person's temper or manner: violent, rough, rude, brusque, boisterous, impetuous and waspish.

heads.title: Moderation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe temperament: gentle, mild, temperate, calm, sober, reasonable and tranquil.

heads.title: Influence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes influence or things; influential and dominant can describe a person.

heads.title: Region
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes places and regions; parochial and provincial can describe a person's narrow outlook.

heads.title: Location
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Adjectives like placed, situate, imbedded and moored describe the position of things, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Inhabitant
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Most adjectives name a person's origin, nationality or domicile (native, Irish, Welsh, naturalized, domiciled), which are group memberships.

heads.title: Abode
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Provincial, rustic, cosmopolitan and rural can describe a person's outlook, but palatial, suburban and metropolitan describe places.

heads.title: Size
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Nearly all adjectives describe size, bulk or build (big, massive, fat, obese, plump), which is a person's looks rather than character, and the rest describe things or quantities.

heads.title: Littleness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Most terms describe physical smallness, though petty and puny can describe a person's conduct or character.

heads.title: Shortness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly physical build (stocky, dumpy, squat) or length of things; curt alone describes a person's manner.

heads.title: Narrowness. Thinness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Adjectives like slender, lean, gaunt and emaciated describe physical build or things, not character.

heads.title: Height
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly physical height or terrain; lofty and exalted can hint at a haughty or elevated manner, but only marginally.

heads.title: Shallowness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Shallow and superficial can describe a person's lack of depth, but the rest describe water depth or surfaces.

heads.title: Verticality
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Upright and straight can describe a person's integrity, but the rest describe position or posture.

heads.title: Pendency
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Pendent, hanging and suspended describe objects; no adjective describes a person's character.

heads.title: Exteriority
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Eccentric and superficial can describe a person, but most adjectives describe location or external surfaces.

heads.title: Circumjacence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Circumjacent, ambient and surrounding describe what encloses things, never a person.

heads.title: Sinistrality
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Sinister can describe a person's menacing character, but left-handed and sinistral describe physical handedness.

heads.title: Straightness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Straight, direct, true and unswerving can describe an honest, frank or steadfast person, but most describe lines and shapes.

heads.title: Flatness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Flat, plane, flush and discoid describe surfaces and shapes; even is used only in the sense of level.

heads.title: Bluntness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Blunt, bluff, obtuse and dull commonly describe a person's manner or wits, though edentate and toothless do not.

heads.title: Opening
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Open, gaping, perforated and porous describe things with openings, not people.

heads.title: Closure
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Closed, shut, impervious and snug describe things or places, not a person's character.

heads.title: Motion
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mercurial can describe a person's volatile temperament, but moving, motive and movable describe motion of things.

heads.title: Quiescence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Quiet, unruffled, unmoved and stay-at-home can describe a person, but most describe stillness of things.

heads.title: Impulse
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Impulsive and dynamic describe a person's temperament, but the rest (impelling, booming, impelled) describe forces or motion.

heads.title: Direction
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Straightforward and unswerving can describe a person's honest, steady character, but most entries describe direction of motion or compass points.

heads.title: Deviation
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Devious, erratic, vagrant and discursive can describe a person, but most entries describe paths, motion or things.

heads.title: Progression
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Progressive and advanced can describe a person's outlook, but advancing and the rest describe motion or development.

heads.title: Convergence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Converging, concurrent, centripetal and asymptotic describe lines, forces and tendencies, not people.

heads.title: Divergence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Diverging, divergent, centrifugal and radiant describe movement away from a point or light, not people.

heads.title: Shortcoming
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Deficient, short and out of depth describe shortfalls in things or circumstances rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Agitation
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Restless and unquiet can describe a person's temperament, but most entries describe physical shaking or movement.

heads.title: Materiality
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Materialistic and impersonal can describe a person's values or manner, but most entries describe physical matter.

heads.title: Levity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Light, airy, buoyant and volatile can describe a person's disposition, but most entries describe weightlessness.

heads.title: Hardness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Stubborn, unbending, unyielding, inflexible, firm and adamant commonly describe a person's character, alongside many physical hardness terms.

heads.title: Softness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Tender, pliant, tractable, yielding and lithe commonly describe a person's nature or manner, alongside many physical softness terms.

heads.title: Elasticity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Resilient and buoyant can describe a person's spirit, but nearly all entries describe physical elasticity in materials.

heads.title: Tenacity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Tenacious and tough can describe a person's resolve, but nearly all entries describe the strength of materials.

heads.title: Brittleness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Brash, weak and frail can describe a person, but most entries describe breakable materials.

heads.title: Gaseity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Gaseous, vaporous and aerial describe gases and air, with no real use for describing a person.

heads.title: Dryness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Dry is the only term that might describe a person's manner, and the rest describe dryness of things.

heads.title: Island
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Insular can describe a narrow-minded person, but seagirt describes islands.

heads.title: Organization
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Organized can describe a person's orderly habits, but organic and vacuolar describe matter and cells.

heads.title: Life
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Animated, vital, full of life and quick can describe a lively temperament, but most entries describe simply being alive.

heads.title: Agriculture
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Rustic, rural and country can describe a person's background or manner, but agricultural, arable and horticultural describe land and produce.

heads.title: Mankind
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Cosmopolitan, social, personal and human can describe a person, while national, civic and public mostly describe institutions.

heads.title: Man
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Manly, virile and masculine describe a person's qualities, but male and he-/his are sex markers or pronouns.

heads.title: Woman
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Ladylike, womanly and effeminate describe a person's manner, but female, she- and the pronouns are sex markers or pronouns.

heads.title: Sexuality
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Hot-blooded, lusty, libidinous, randy, homosexual, gay and bisexual describe a person's sexual nature or orientation, though several words describe acts or things.

heads.title: Physical Insensibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Callous, unfeeling, hardened, thick-skinned and obtuse describe a person's temperament, while numb, comatose and paralytic describe physical states.

heads.title: Insipidity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Wishy-washy, vapid, insipid, weak and mild can describe a dull or spineless person, but bland, stale and flat mostly describe food or things.

heads.title: Bitterness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Bitter and acerbic can describe a resentful or sharp-tongued person, but acrid and acerb mostly describe tastes and substances.

heads.title: Silence
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Silent and solemn can describe a taciturn or grave person, but most of the words describe sound, stillness or places.

heads.title: Deafness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Deaf and hard of hearing describe a physical condition, not a person's character.

heads.title: Dimness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Dim, dingy and lackluster describe light and appearance of things, with only a stretch to a dull-witted person.

heads.title: Transparency
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Transparent, serene and clear mostly describe substances and light, with only figurative use for a person.

heads.title: Opacity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Opaque, turbid, murky and hazy describe substances, air and light, not people.

heads.title: Achromatism
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: These adjectives describe colour and complexion (pale, pallid, ashen, sallow, wan, ghastly), which is a person's looks, not what sort of person they are.

heads.title: Whiteness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: These adjectives describe whiteness or colour (white, snowy, hoary, blond, fair), and 'candid' here means white, not frank, so none describe a person's nature.

heads.title: Vision
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Keen-eyed, hawk-eyed and eagle-eyed describe physical sight, and the rest are purely about vision.

heads.title: Blindness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Blind, sightless and wall-eyed describe a physical condition, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Intellect
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Intellectual, brainy, cerebral, rational and spiritual describe a person's mental disposition and abilities.

heads.title: Absence or want of Intellect
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Most adjectives (thoughtless, moronic, idiotic, brainless, void of reason) directly describe a person's lack of intellect.

heads.title: Thought
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Most adjectives (thoughtful, meditative, reflective, contemplative, studious, sedate, introspective, philosophical) describe a person's habitual cast of mind.

heads.title: Incogitancy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Many adjectives (unintellectual, unthinking, inconsiderate, mindless, vacuous, thoughtless) describe a person who does not think, though some describe states or things.

heads.title: Idea
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general

heads.title: Topic
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: The adjectives describe what is in someone's mind at a moment, not what sort of person they are.

heads.title: Curiosity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives (curious, inquisitive, overcurious, prying, snoopy, nosy) describe a person's habitual disposition.

heads.title: Incuriosity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives (incurious, uninquisitive, indifferent, detached, aloof) describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Attention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Attentive, observant and alert describe traits, but most adjectives (absorbed, rapt, engaged in, transfixed) describe momentary states.

heads.title: Inattention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Many adjectives (heedless, bird-witted, scatter-brained, hare-brained, offhand, unreflective) describe a person's habitual carelessness, while others describe acts or states.

heads.title: Care
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Careful, considerate, vigilant, watchful and particular describe traits, but many others (on guard, on watch, awake) describe momentary conditions.

heads.title: Neglect
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives (negligent, neglectful, careless, remiss, imprudent, unwary, perfunctory) describe a person's habitual conduct.

heads.title: Inquiry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe questions, inquiries and matters under discussion rather than people.

heads.title: Answer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe answers and replies, not the person giving them.

heads.title: Experiment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe experiments, tests and provisional or unproven things rather than people.

heads.title: Comparison
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe comparisons between things and do not describe a person.

heads.title: Incomparability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe things that cannot be compared, and 'incomparable' is only a stretch when applied to a person.

heads.title: Discrimination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Discriminating and nice can describe a person's fastidious taste, but distinctive and discriminative mostly describe things.

heads.title: Indiscrimination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Indiscriminate, undiscriminating and promiscuous describe a person's habits, but indistinguishable and unmeasured do not.

heads.title: Identification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Measurement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe measuring methods and perceptible or measurable qualities of things, not people.

heads.title: Evidence
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe evidence and its relation to conclusions, not people.

heads.title: Counter Evidence
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe counter-evidence and unsupported claims; only 'contradictory' could loosely describe a person.

heads.title: Qualification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives (qualifying, conditional, hedged, restricted) describe statements, terms and conditions, not a person.

heads.title: Possibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Words like possible, feasible, accessible and within reach describe what can happen or be done, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Impossibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes impossibility of things; only 'visionary' can describe a person's idealistic temperament.

heads.title: Probability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly about plausibility of things, though 'reasonable' can describe a person's sensible character.

heads.title: Improbability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes improbable events; 'wild' and 'strange' can describe a person's conduct or nature.

heads.title: Certainty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes certainty of facts, though 'decided' and 'positive' can describe a resolute or confident person.

heads.title: Uncertainty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes unclear matters, though 'indecisive' and 'undecided' can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Reasoning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives such as argumentative, disputatious, polemical and rationalistic readily describe a person's habits of thought and speech.

heads.title: Intuition & Sophistry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Words like impulsive, intuitive and instinctive can describe a person's way of acting, but most describe arguments or views.

heads.title: Demonstration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes proofs and arguments; 'demonstrative' is the only one that can describe a person's expressive manner.

heads.title: Confutation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Refers to refuting arguments or claims and describes no person.

heads.title: Judgment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Describes judgments and conclusions; 'judging' is only marginally a description of a person.

heads.title: Discovery
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Misjudgment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Prejudiced, narrow-minded, intolerant, dogmatic, fanatical and shortsighted are clear traits of a person's attitudes.

heads.title: Overestimation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its only adjective, overestimated, describes a value placed on something, not a person.

heads.title: Underestimation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes things that are undervalued; 'depreciating' can describe a belittling or self-deprecating person.

heads.title: Belief
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Confident, cocksure, confiding, unsuspecting and convinced describe a person's dispositions of belief.

heads.title: Unbelief. Doubt
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Skeptical, suspicious, distrustful and unbelieving describe a person's attitude of doubt, though many entries describe things.

heads.title: Credulity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Credulous, gullible, naive, silly and superstitious are clear personal failings of belief.

heads.title: Incredulity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Incredulous, skeptical, cynical, distrustful and suspicious describe a person's habitual disposition to doubt.

heads.title: Assent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes agreement among things or votes; 'acquiescent' and 'content' can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Dissent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives name kinds of people by their opinions or allegiance (dissident, protestant, recusant, sectarian, schismatic, heterodox, intolerant).

heads.title: Knowledge
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe a state of being informed rather than what someone is like, though a few such as 'knowing' and 'alive to' can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Ignorance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Several describe a person's upbringing or outlook (ignorant, uncultivated, untutored, unschooled, misguided, unenlightened), so they can say what someone is like.

heads.title: Scholar
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Ignoramus
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The single adjective 'shallow' is a common description of a person's character or mind.

heads.title: Truth
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe statements, accounts or things as true or exact; only a few, such as 'realistic' or 'precise', can describe a person.

heads.title: Error
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe statements, beliefs or things as wrong; only 'false' and 'untrue' can describe a person's deceitfulness or faithlessness.

heads.title: Maxim
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: All four adjectives describe sayings or maxims, not people.

heads.title: Absurdity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Some describe a person's manner or habits (quibbling, extravagant, fantastic, absurd, ridiculous), but most describe ideas, acts or statements.

heads.title: Intelligence, Wisdom
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Nearly all describe a person's mental quality, such as intelligent, shrewd, astute, quick or canny.

heads.title: Imbecility. Folly
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Nearly all describe a person's lack of wit or sense, such as mindless, brainless, pig headed or fat witted.

heads.title: Sage
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Venerable' can describe a person, but 'emeritus' and 'reverenced' describe status or regard rather than character.

heads.title: Fool
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Sanity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most describe a settled, sound mind and manner in a person, such as rational, sensible, lucid, self-possessed and sober-minded.

heads.title: Insanity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Madman

heads.title: Memory

heads.title: Oblivion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: A few such as 'forgetful', 'oblivious' and 'heedless' can describe a person's habits, but most describe things that are forgotten.

heads.title: Expectation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Describe passing states of anticipation (agape, on tenterhooks, all agog) rather than what a person is like.

heads.title: Inexpectation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe passing surprise or things that were unexpected; 'unpredictable' can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Disappointment

heads.reason: Describe passing states of disappointment; 'disgruntled' can describe a person's disposition, but the rest are momentary.

heads.title: Foresight
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Farsighted', 'farseeing' and 'prescient' commonly describe a person's habit of mind.

heads.title: Prediction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe omens, predictions or things that portend events, not people.

heads.title: Omen

heads.title: Oracle
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Supposition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives (supposing, mooted, conjectural, hypothetical, presumptive and so on) describe ideas and assumptions rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Analogy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The single adjective 'analogical' describes reasoning by comparison, not a person.

heads.title: Imagination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Many adjectives describe temperament and habits of mind, such as imaginative, romantic, flighty, enthusiastic, fanatic, Quixotic and Utopian, used of people.

heads.title: Meaning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives (expressive, pithy, significant, literal, synonymous) describe words and ideas, not a person.

heads.title: Unmeaningness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives (meaningless, nonsensical, trashy, trivial, quibbling) mainly describe ideas, talk and things, with only a marginal fit for a person.

heads.title: Intelligibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly about the clarity of ideas and speech, though 'plain' and 'positive' can marginally describe a person.

heads.title: Unintelligibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mainly about ideas and texts being hard to understand, though 'inscrutable' and 'enigmatic' can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Equivocalness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes statements and meanings as ambiguous, though 'equivocal' can describe a person's dubious character.

heads.title: Metaphor
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe figures of speech and style, not people.

heads.title: Interpretation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes explanations and translations, though 'polyglot' (a person who knows many languages) and 'literal' can describe a person.

heads.title: Misinterpretation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe texts and meanings that were misread or cannot be translated, not people.

heads.title: Interpreter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Manifestation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes things that are evident or conspicuous, though 'demonstrative' (openly emotional) and 'arrant' (utter, as in an arrant coward) can describe a person.

heads.title: Latency. Implication
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe hidden or unstated things such as latent qualities and implications, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Information
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixed: 'communicative' and 'plain spoken' describe a person's manner of speaking, while the rest describe reports and documents.

heads.title: Correction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The single adjective 'corrective' describes a remedy or action, not a person.

heads.title: Concealment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixed: 'secret', 'close' and 'private' can describe a reserved or secretive person, while most describe hidden things, rites and places.

heads.title: Disclosure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Open' can describe a frank, open-hearted person, but 'disclosed' describes things revealed.

heads.title: Ambush
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives camouflaged, hidden and concealed describe concealed positions or things, not people's character.

heads.title: Publication
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe published works, circulation and publicity; 'arrant' and 'notorious' only marginally describe a person.

heads.title: News
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe rumours, reports and the manner of news, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Secret
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Words like involved, mazy and confidential describe matters, documents or arrangements rather than a person's character.

heads.title: Messenger
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Affirmation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Several adjectives such as positive, dogmatic, confident, emphatic and decided commonly describe a person's manner of asserting opinions.

heads.title: Negation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes statements or propositions; only negative, as a temperament, can describe a person.

heads.title: Teaching
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe teaching or instruction, though didactic and academic can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Misteaching
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Misteaching and unedifying describe instruction or its effect, not a person.

heads.title: Learning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Studious, scholarly and teachable are ordinary traits of a person who learns.

heads.title: Teacher

heads.title: Learner
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: In leading strings describes a person's dependent state or circumstance rather than their character.

heads.title: School
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Scholastic, collegiate and educational mostly describe institutions, though academic can describe a person as a scholar.

heads.title: Veracity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Truthful, sincere, candid, frank, honest, trustworthy and guileless are core character traits.

heads.title: Falsehood
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Deceitful, dishonest, mendacious, faithless, evasive and disingenuous describe a person's character and conduct.

heads.title: Deception

heads.title: Untruth

heads.title: Deceiver

heads.title: Exaggeration

heads.title: Indication

heads.title: Record

heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Representation

heads.title: Misrepresentation

heads.title: Painting
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Painted, pictorial, graphic and pencil describe artworks and media, not people.

heads.title: Sculpture
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives (sculptured, in relief, ceramic, marble) describe artworks and materials, not a person.

heads.title: Engraving
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Artist
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Language
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Letter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Literal, alphabetical, abecedarian and syllabic describe letters and writing systems, not people.

heads.title: Word
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Verbal, nominal, conjugate and derivative describe words and their forms, not a person's character.

heads.title: Neologism
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Archaic and colloquial describe language, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Nomenclature
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Named, ycleped, known as and nominal concern what someone is called, not what they are like.

heads.title: Misnomer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Self-styled is a loose person-describing term, but most of the list (nameless, anonymous, unnamed) concerns names and naming.

heads.title: Phrase
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Grammar
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Solecism

heads.title: Perspicuity

heads.title: Obscurity

heads.title: Conciseness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Diffuseness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Vigor

heads.title: Feebleness

heads.title: Plainness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Plain, simple, homespun, natural and matter-of-fact can describe a person, but most describe unadorned style.

heads.title: Ornament
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Elegance

heads.title: Inelegance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Voice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Vocal and articulate can describe a person, but the rest (phonetic, oral, stertorous) describe the voice or sounds.

heads.title: Aphony
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes voice quality or a physical inability to speak (deafmute, tongueless, hoarse), not a settled trait of a person.

heads.title: Speech
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mainly describes speech as a medium, though outspoken, eloquent and rhetorical can describe a person.

heads.title: Stammering

heads.reason: Mostly describes manner of voice in stammering, though affected and tremulous can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Loquacity

heads.title: Taciturnity

heads.title: Allocution

heads.title: Conversation

heads.title: Soliloquy

heads.title: Writing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives such as written, uncial and cuneiform describe documents and scripts, not people.

heads.title: Printing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives describe printed matter and typesetting, not people.

heads.title: Correspondence

heads.title: Description

heads.reason: Adjectives describe accounts, portrayals and narratives, such as graphic, legendary and storied, not people.

heads.title: Dissertation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Discursive and expository describe treatises and writing, not people.

heads.title: Compendium
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Compendious, synoptic and abridged describe summaries and works, not people.

heads.title: Poetry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives describe verse forms and poetic works; poetic is only occasionally applied to a person.

heads.title: Prose
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Prosy and prosaic can describe a dull, matter-of-fact person, but the rest describe writing and form.

heads.title: The Drama
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Will

heads.title: Necessity

heads.title: Willingness

heads.title: Unwillingness

heads.title: Resolution

heads.title: Perseverance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (persevering, steadfast, steady, persistent, pertinacious, staunch) describe a person's enduring disposition.

heads.title: Irresolution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (irresolute, double-minded, half-hearted, fickle, vacillating, light-minded) describe a person's temperament or habits of mind.

heads.title: Obstinacy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (obstinate, stubborn, pig-headed, mulish, sulky, self-willed, perverse) describe a person's character.

heads.title: Tergiversation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Ductile, slippery as an eel, trimming, ambidextrous and reactionary all describe a person's habitual conduct or stance.

heads.title: Caprice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (capricious, eccentric, whimsical, crotchety, skittish, wayward, captious) describe a person's temperament and conduct.

heads.title: Choice

heads.title: Absence of Choice

heads.title: Rejection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Predetermination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Calculated and cunning can describe a person, but most adjectives describe plans and acts done in advance.

heads.title: Impulse

heads.reason: Impulsive, unguarded and natural can describe a person, but most adjectives describe acts done without premeditation.

heads.title: Habit

heads.title: Desuetude

heads.reason: Unseasoned and untrained can describe a person's inexperience, but the rest describe things, usages or states.

heads.title: Motive

heads.reason: Persuasive, seductive, disposed, inspired and smitten can describe a person, but many (motive, induced, by) describe influences or things.

heads.title: Absence of Motive

heads.reason: Capricious and aimless can describe a person, but without rhyme or reason describes actions or events.

heads.title: Dissuasion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Repressed can describe a person's temperament, but the rest describe warnings and words that dissuade.

heads.title: Pretext
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Good

heads.title: Evil
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Intention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Chance

heads.title: Pursuit

heads.title: Avoidance

heads.title: Relinquishment

heads.title: Business

heads.title: Plan
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Planned, strategic and prepared describe schemes and readiness, with at most a weak use for a person.

heads.title: Method

heads.title: Mid-course

heads.title: Circuit

heads.title: Requirement

heads.title: Instrumentality

heads.title: Store

heads.title: Provision

heads.title: Waste

heads.title: Sufficiency

heads.title: Utility

heads.title: Remedy
