heads.reason: Describes remedies, medicines and treatments, which are things.

heads.title: Bane
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Safety
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Describes being safe or out of danger, which are circumstances rather than what a person is like.

heads.title: Danger
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: A mix: "untrustworthy" and "insecure" can describe a person's traits, while most describe dangerous situations.

heads.title: Refuge
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Pitfall
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Warning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Describes warnings and cautions, which are things.

heads.title: Alarm
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Single adjective describing something that causes alarm, not a person.

heads.title: Preservation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes preserved or undamaged things, but "conservative" can describe a person's cautious, traditional temperament.

heads.title: Escape
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Escape adjectives describe a getaway or a fugitive's state, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Deliverance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Rescue and redemption adjectives describe a situation or thing being saved, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Preparation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Preparation adjectives describe plans and works in progress, though "provident" (thrifty, prudent) can describe a person.

heads.title: Nonpreparation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes unfinished or crude things, though "green", "raw", "unprepared" and "coarse" can describe a person's inexperience or manners.

heads.title: Essay
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Trial and testing adjectives describe methods and probation, with "tentative" only marginally a personal manner.

heads.title: Undertaking
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The sole adjective "undertaking" describes an enterprise, not a person.

heads.title: Use
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Use adjectives describe objects in use or worn by use, not people.

heads.title: Disuse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Disuse adjectives describe unused goods, funds and things, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Misuse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The sole adjective "misused" describes a thing that has been wrongly used.

heads.title: Action
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Action adjectives describe ongoing activity or status such as being on duty, not a person's character.

heads.title: Inaction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Passive" can describe a person's temperament, but the rest describe employment status or things not done.

heads.title: Activity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives (lively, vivacious, spirited, brisk, nimble, alive) readily describe a person's energetic temperament.

heads.title: Inactivity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (lazy, indolent, slothful, idle, listless, dilatory) describe a person's habitual disposition.

heads.title: Haste
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives (hasty, impetuous, hotheaded, brusque, fussy, pushing) describe a person's habitual manner, though others describe events.

heads.title: Leisure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Calm", "quiet", "deliberate" and "leisurely" describe temperament, but several others describe circumstances like "at loose ends".

heads.title: Exertion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Hard-working", "painstaking", "energetic" and "strenuous" describe people, but most adjectives describe tasks and labours.

heads.title: Repose
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Relaxed" can describe a person's easy manner, but the rest describe rest or unstrained states.

heads.title: Fatigue
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Fatigue adjectives describe temporary physical states of tiredness rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Refreshment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Refreshment adjectives describe a restored state or a refreshing thing, not a person's character.

heads.title: Agent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Workshop
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Its adjectives (at work, at the office, at the shop, working) describe a person's situation or place of work, not what they are like.

heads.title: Conduct
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Businesslike, practical and executive can describe a person's manner, but strategical and conducting describe activities rather than people.

heads.title: Direction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Directing and hegemonic describe acts of control or dominance, not a person's character.

heads.title: Director
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Advice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Recommendatory describes a statement or letter, not a person.

heads.title: Council
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Senatorial, congressional, legislative and similar words describe bodies, laws or procedures rather than a person's character.

heads.title: Precept
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Skill
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (skillful, dexterous, adroit, expert, deft, proficient, masterly) describe a person's competence shown in how they act.

heads.title: Unskillfulness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (inexpert, bungling, clumsy, gauche, incompetent, slovenly, unteachable) describe a person's lack of skill or failings in conduct.

heads.title: Proficient
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Bungler
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Cunning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (cunning, crafty, artful, subtle, designing, Machiavelian, politic) describe a person's habitual scheming character.

heads.title: Artlessness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (artless, naive, sincere, frank, candid, ingenuous, guileless, unaffected) describe a person's temperament and openness.

heads.title: Difficulty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes tasks and things (hard, tough, laborious, onerous), with only a few person-descriptors such as crabby, crabbed or difficult to deal with.

heads.title: Facility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes tasks (easy, facile, accessible), but tractable, submissive, yielding and glib can describe a person.

heads.title: Hindrance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes obstacles and burdens (hindering, cumbrous, burdensome), with only a few words such as obstructive, obtrusive or alone applying to people.

heads.title: Aid
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Helpful, friendly, amicable, neighborly and well-disposed describe a person, but auxiliary, ancillary, accessory and subsidiary describe things.

heads.title: Opposition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (antagonistic, hostile, unfriendly, competitive, emulous, up in arms) describe a person's attitude towards others.

heads.title: Cooperation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Cooperative and participative can describe a person, but cooperating, additive and synergetic describe actions or things.

heads.title: Opponent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Auxiliary
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Party
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Words like in league, banded together and joined together describe a person's association with others, not what they are like.

heads.title: Discord
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Quarrelsome, disputatious, factious, litigious and polemic describe a person's combative temperament, though many others describe situations.

heads.title: Concord
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Congenial, conciliatory and harmonious can describe a person, but concordant, united and at peace mostly describe situations or agreement.

heads.title: Defiance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Defiant describes a person's attitude and temperament.

heads.title: Attack
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Aggressive is a clear personality trait, while attacking and offensive describe acts and up in arms is a passing mood.

heads.title: Defense
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes fortifications and armour, though defensive and hardened can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Retaliation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives mainly describe retaliatory acts rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Resistance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Recalcitrant, stubborn and resistant describe a person's disposition, but repulsive, repellant and proof against describe things.

heads.title: Contention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Belligerent, combative, pugnacious, bellicose, contentious and competitive are all common character traits.

heads.title: Peace
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Peaceable, peaceful, calm, tranquil, pacific and dovish readily describe a person's temperament or outlook.

heads.title: Warfare
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Belligerent, combative, bellicose and warlike can describe a person, but most of the list (under arms, in the field, at war with) describes passing states or situations.

heads.title: Pacification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Conciliatory describes a person's disposition, but composing and pacified describe passing states.

heads.title: Mediation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mediatory describes a role or act, not a person's character.

heads.title: Submission
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Submissive, resigned and nonresisting describe a person's disposition, while crouching, downtrodden and on one's bended knee describe posture or circumstance.

heads.title: Combatant
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Arms
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Arena
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Completion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Completion adjectives such as final, conclusive, exhaustive and done describe tasks and results, not people.

heads.title: Noncompletion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Unfinished, uncompleted, in progress and half-baked describe unfinished work and states of things rather than a person.

heads.title: Success
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Success adjectives describe outcomes and passing states such as flushed with success or in full swing, not a person's character.

heads.title: Failure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Failure adjectives describe outcomes and results such as abortive, fruitless and stillborn, not the person.

heads.title: Trophy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Prosperity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Prosperity adjectives describe a person's financial or fortunate circumstances, not their character.

heads.title: Adversity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Adversity adjectives describe misfortune and circumstances such as in trouble or under a cloud, not character.

heads.title: Mediocrity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Authority
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Dominant and arbitrary describe a person's temperament, but most of the list (at the head, in one's grasp, under control) describes position or power.

heads.title: Government
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Imperious and authoritative describe character, and royalist, republican and aristocratic name a person's allegiance or class, but most describe systems of government.

heads.title: Politics
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Partisan can describe a person's allegiance, but political mostly describes affairs of state.

heads.title: Laxity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lax, loose, slack, weak, relaxed, unbridled and anarchical all readily describe a person's conduct or character.

heads.title: Severity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Severe, strict, harsh, dour, stern, austere, hard-headed and inexorable describe a person's temperament and manner.

heads.title: Lenity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lenient, mild, gentle, tolerant, indulgent, easy-going and forbearing are all ordinary character traits of a person.

heads.title: Command
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Commanding" describes a person's manner, while "callable" does not describe a person.

heads.title: Disobedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Disobedient, unruly, insubordinate, incorrigible, mutinous, seditious and recalcitrant describe a person's habitual conduct.

heads.title: Obedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Obedient, compliant, loyal, faithful, devoted, resigned and passive describe a person's disposition and conduct.

heads.title: Compulsion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Peremptory can describe a person's manner, but most of the others (compelling, compulsory, obligatory, stringent) describe things or acts.

heads.title: Master
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Servant
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: All four describe a person's employment or condition of service, not what the person is like.

heads.title: Scepter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Freedom
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Free, independent, unconstrained and unbuttoned can describe a person's disposition, but most others (at large, uncaught, scot-free) describe circumstances.

heads.title: Subjection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Dependent, subordinate, downtrodden, henpecked, enslaved and feudal describe a person's standing and habitual submissiveness.

heads.title: Liberation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Liberated" can describe a person's attitudes, as in a liberated person, though it is a single adjective.

heads.title: Restraint
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Restrained, constrained, stiff, strait-laced and hidebound describe character, while most others describe confinement or circumstances.

heads.title: Prison
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Keeper
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Prisoner
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: All describe a prisoner's confinement or legal state, which is a passing circumstance rather than what the person is like.

heads.title: Commission
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Commissioned" describes an official appointment or status, not a personal trait.

heads.title: Abrogation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: "Abrogated" describes a law or right being repealed, which is a thing, not a person.

heads.title: Resignation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Consignee
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Deputy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Acting, vice and accredited describe a role or office held, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Permission
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Permissive and indulgent can describe a person's disposition, but most others (lawful, legal, chartered, patent) describe things.

heads.title: Prohibition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Exclusive can describe a clannish or snobbish person, but the rest (prohibitive, contraband, unlicensed, impermissible) describe things or acts.

heads.title: Consent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Squeezable can describe a person who is easily pressured, while consenting describes an act and unconditional describes an agreement.

heads.title: Offer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Its adjectives (offered, for sale, to let, on hire) describe goods and terms, and none describes a person's character.

heads.title: Refusal
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Refusing, uncomplying, recusant and restive can describe a person's disposition, but refused, ungranted, impossible and out of the question describe things.

heads.title: Request
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Importunate and clamorous can describe a persistent or demanding person, but most of the adjectives (suppliant, on one's knees, cap in hand) describe a passing manner of asking.

heads.title: Deprecation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Deprecatory, intercessory and protested describe acts or statements rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Petitioner
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Promise
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Promising, promissory and under hand and seal describe pledges and documents, while committed and pledged can describe a dedicated person, so the head is mixed.

heads.title: Release from engagement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Its single adjective, absolute, describes a release or a ruler, not a person's character.

heads.title: Compact
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Agreed and under hand and seal describe agreements, though conventional can describe a person who keeps to convention.

heads.title: Conditions
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Conditional, provisional, fenced and hedged in describe terms and arrangements, and only guarded can describe a person's cautious manner.

heads.title: Security
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Observance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Faithful, loyal, true, punctual, punctilious and observant are standard descriptions of a person's character and conduct.

heads.title: Nonobservance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lawless, transgressive, evasive and elusive commonly describe a person's conduct and disposition, with violating as a weaker fit.

heads.title: Compromise
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Acquisition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Profitable, gainful, lucrative and remunerative describe transactions or work, not a person's character.

heads.title: Loss
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Bereaved, bereft, out of pocket and deprived of describe a person's passing state or circumstances, not what they are like.

heads.title: Possession
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Endowed with and master of can describe a person's qualities or skill, but most adjectives (on hand, in stock, laden with, worth) describe possessions or conditions.

heads.title: Exemption
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Exempt from, immune from, devoid of and without describe a person's lack or status in a circumstance, not character.

heads.title: Participation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Partaking describes taking part in something, and communistic can describe a person's political allegiance, but that is only a weak fit.

heads.title: Possessor
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Property
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Landed and feudal can name a class a person belongs to, but the rest (one's own, manorial, lease-hold) describe property.

heads.title: Retention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Retentive and tenacious can describe a person's memory or resolve, but the rest (inalienable, in strict settlement, undisposed) describe property and things.

heads.title: Relinquishment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Relinquished, cast off, unowned and unappropriated describe things given up or unclaimed, and derelict is at most a rare fit for a person.

heads.title: Transfer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Alienable and negotiable describe property or instruments that can be transferred.

heads.title: Giving
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Charitable and giving describe a person's generous disposition, but most of the other adjectives (allowable, communicable, tributary) describe things or payments.

heads.title: Receiving
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Receiving, received, secondhand and unbestowed describe objects or transfers, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Apportionment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Apportioning and respective describe division and relation, not a person's character.

heads.title: Lending
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lending and lent describe an act of loaning, not a trait of a person.

heads.title: Borrowing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Taking
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Predatory, rapacious, parasitic and lupine can describe a grasping person, while prehensile, raptorial and taking mostly describe things or acts.

heads.title: Restitution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Restoring describes an act or process of giving back, not a person.

heads.title: Stealing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Thieving, thievish, light-fingered, furtive and predatory describe a person's habitual conduct, with only stolen describing goods.

heads.title: Thief
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Booty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Barter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Commercial, mercantile and trading mostly describe goods, markets and trade rather than a person.

heads.title: Purchase
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Purchased describes goods that have been bought.

heads.title: Sale
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: These adjectives describe goods offered or sold, not people.

heads.title: Merchant
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Merchandise
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Mart
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Stock Market
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Securities
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Money
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Monetary, pecuniary, fiscal and financial describe money matters; sterling is at most a faint personal sense.

heads.title: Treasurer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Treasury
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Wealth
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Wealthy, rich and well off describe a person's financial means, which is a circumstance, though the rich can be a class.

heads.title: Poverty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Poor, penniless and hard up describe a person's financial circumstance, not character, though the poor can be a class.

heads.title: Credit
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Credited and accredited describe the attribution or authorisation of something, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Debt
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Indebted, liable and in debt describe a financial state or obligation, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Payment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Paid and paying describe settled accounts, not a person's character.

heads.title: Nonpayment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Insolvent, bankrupt and behindhand describe financial standing or non-payment, not personal character.

heads.title: Expenditure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Expended and expending describe spending, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Receipt
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Receiving and received describe the act of getting something, not a person.

heads.title: Accounts
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Accountable and accounting describe transactions and records, with no sense of a person's character.

heads.title: Price
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mercenary and venal can describe a person's money-driven or corruptible nature, but the rest concern prices and duties.

heads.title: Value
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Worthy and estimable can describe a person of merit, while valuable, worthwhile and full of worth mostly describe things.

heads.title: Worthlessness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Useless, cheap and slapdash can describe a person, but worthless, valueless and shoddy mostly describe goods or work.

heads.title: Discount
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The only adjective, discounting, describes a price reduction, not a person.

heads.title: Dearness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe high prices, though unreasonable and extravagant can describe a person's conduct.

heads.title: Cheapness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Nearly all adjectives describe low prices or free goods, with only reasonable hinting at a person's disposition.

heads.title: Liberality
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Liberal, generous, hospitable, unselfish, open-handed and open-hearted are all ordinary traits of a person.

heads.title: Economy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Economical, frugal, thrifty, sparing and chary are habits of a person's conduct with money.

heads.title: Greed
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Greedy, avaricious, covetous, grasping and rapacious are standard descriptions of a person's character.

heads.title: Prodigality
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Prodigal, thriftless, improvident, wasteful and lavish describe a person's spending habits and disposition.

heads.title: Parsimony
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Stingy, miserly, mean, niggardly and close-fisted are ordinary descriptions of a person's character.

heads.title: Affections
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Inborn, inbred, ingrained, prone, inclined and predisposed describe a person's natural bent and temperament.

heads.title: Feeling
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Emotional and sensitive-type words can describe a person, but most adjectives (sharp, keen, cutting, galvanic-type sense) describe qualities of sensation or things.

heads.title: Sensibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Sensitive, impressionable, tender-hearted, sentimental, romantic, spirited and vivacious describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Insensibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Heartless, unfeeling, apathetic, phlegmatic, cold-blooded and soulless describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Excitation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Excited, overwrought, tense and feverish mostly describe passing states rather than a settled character, though a person can be prone to them.

heads.title: Excitability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Excitable, high-strung, impatient, hysterical, moody, mercurial and restless describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Inexcitability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Imperturbable, stoical, sedate, demure, easy-going and cool-headed describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Pleasure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives (glad, happy, blissful, at ease) describe a person's feeling, but many others are momentary raptures or idioms about things.

heads.title: Pain

heads.reason: Words like worried, uneasy, afflicted and stricken describe a person's suffering, but most are passing states rather than what someone is like.

heads.title: Pleasurableness

heads.title: . Painfulness

heads.reason: Most adjectives describe things that hurt or displease, though obnoxious, disagreeable and unpopular can describe a person.

heads.title: Content

heads.title: Discontent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Discontented, dissident, malcontent, exacting, hypercritical, sulky and glum mostly describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Regret
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Relief

heads.reason: Relieving, soothing, palliative and similar words describe remedies and things, not people.

heads.title: Aggravation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Cheerfulness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Cheerful, cheery, blithe, chipper, buoyant and debonair describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Dejection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Melancholy, gloomy, spiritless and joyless describe a person's disposition, but dismal, murky, dreary and funereal mostly describe things.

heads.title: Rejoicing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Jubilant, exultant, elated and delighted describe a person's feelings, though mostly as passing moods.

heads.title: Lamentation

heads.title: Amusement

heads.title: Weariness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Tiresome, dull, dry, prosy and slow can describe a person, but most adjectives describe tedious things or activities.

heads.title: Wit
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Witty, quick-witted, jocular, humorous, whimsical, puckish and waggish describe a person's habitual manner of mind.

heads.title: Dullness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Beauty

heads.title: Ugliness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Ornament
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Jewelry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: The adjectives 'bejeweled', 'diamond' and 'gemological' describe objects and materials, not people.

heads.title: Blemish
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Every adjective describes physical marks or appearance ('freckled', 'bloodshot'), not what a person is like.

heads.title: Simplicity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Some adjectives describe a person's manner ('simple', 'ingenuous', 'unaffected'), but many describe style or objects ('chaste', 'bald', 'flat').

heads.title: Taste
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Refined', 'cultivated', 'dainty' and 'artistic' describe people, while 'tasty', 'pure' and 'cute' mostly describe things.

heads.title: Vulgarity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('coarse', 'ill bred', 'underbred', 'unladylike', 'ungentlemanly') directly describe a person's manners and breeding.

heads.title: Fashion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('genteel', 'well-bred', 'gentlemanly', 'polished', 'courtly') describe a person's manners and social standing.

heads.title: Ridiculousness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Words like 'droll', 'funny', 'odd', 'whimsical' and 'queer' can describe a person, but 'ridiculous', 'grotesque' and 'farcical' mostly describe things or events.

heads.title: Ridicule

heads.title: Hope

heads.title: Hopelessness

heads.title: Fear

heads.reason: Most adjectives ('timid', 'nervous', 'apprehensive', 'faint-hearted', 'fidgety') describe a person's temperament and fears.

heads.title: Courage
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('brave', 'valiant', 'intrepid', 'plucky', 'resolute', 'bold') describe a person's character.

heads.title: Cowardice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Nearly all adjectives ('cowardly', 'timid', 'spiritless', 'milksop', 'lily-livered') describe a person's character.

heads.title: Rashness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('rash', 'reckless', 'headstrong', 'hotheaded', 'madcap', 'heedless') describe a person's habits of conduct.

heads.title: Caution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('cautious', 'wary', 'prudent', 'discreet', 'circumspect', 'self-possessed') describe a person's habitual conduct and temperament.

heads.title: Desire
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives ('desirous', 'wistful', 'curious', 'sedulous', 'craving') describe a person's dispositions, though 'hungry' and 'thirsty' are literal states.

heads.title: Indifference
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('phlegmatic', 'aloof', 'easygoing', 'insouciant', 'unambitious', 'unapproachable') describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Dislike
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Fastidiousness

heads.title: Satiety

heads.title: Wonder

heads.title: Ostentation

heads.title: Celebration

heads.title: Boasting

heads.title: Insolence

heads.title: Servility

heads.title: Love

heads.title: Irascibility

heads.title: Sullenness

heads.title: Benevolence

heads.title: Malevolence

heads.title: Acquittal
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Acquitted, not guilty, unpunished and not liable describe a legal outcome or passing circumstance, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Condemnation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Condemnatory, guilty, condemned and self-convicted describe judgments or a legal status, not a settled trait.

heads.title: Punishment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Punishing, penal, punitive and castigatory describe punishments and their nature, not a person.

heads.title: Reward
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Remunerative, rewarding, retributive and satisfactory describe payments and outcomes, not people.

heads.title: Penalty

heads.title: Scourge

heads.title: Deity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Mostly describe deity or sacred things (almighty, omniscient, theocratic), though holy, spiritual and theistic can describe a person's faith.

heads.title: Angel
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Angelic, seraphic, cherubic and saintly commonly describe a person's gentle, virtuous character.

heads.title: Satan
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Satanic, diabolic and devilish describe a person's wicked or mischievous nature, though infernal mostly describes things.

heads.title: Jupiter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Its adjectives are mostly figurative comparisons for beauty or otherworldliness, and only 'god-like' loosely describes a person.

heads.title: Demon
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe supernatural beings or eerie things, but 'impish', 'fiendish', 'elfish' and 'demonic' can describe a person's temperament or conduct.

heads.title: Heaven
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes heaven as a place or state, though 'heavenly' and 'beatific' can describe a person's goodness or expression.

heads.title: Hell
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe hell, its torments and things hellish, with no ordinary use for a person's character.

heads.title: Theology
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Religious' describes a person's faith, while 'theological' and 'denominational' describe doctrine and institutions.

heads.title: Orthodoxy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('orthodox', 'faithful', 'Christian', 'evangelical', 'catholic') name a person's belief or religious allegiance.

heads.title: Heterodoxy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('heretical', 'pagan', 'heathen', 'gentile', 'dissenting', 'recusant', 'dissident') name a person's faith, group or dissent.

heads.title: Judeo-Christian Revelation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes scripture, revelation and sacred texts, though 'evangelical' and 'prophetic' can describe a believer.

heads.title: Pseudo-Revelation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Piety
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('pious', 'devout', 'godly', 'humble', 'saintly', 'faithful') describe a person's religious character.

heads.title: Impiety
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('impious', 'profane', 'blasphemous', 'hardened', 'sanctimonious', 'bigoted', 'fanatical') describe a person's irreverent or hypocritical character.

heads.title: Irreligion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives ('irreligious', 'godless', 'atheistic', 'skeptical', 'freethinking', 'worldly') describe a person's lack of religious belief or worldly outlook.

heads.title: Worship
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Devout', 'reverent' and 'worshipping' describe a person, while 'devotional', 'pure' and 'solemn' are more about acts or occasions.

heads.title: Idolatry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: The single adjective 'idolatrous' describes a practice and only loosely a worshipper.

heads.title: Sorcery
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Adjectives like 'magic', 'cabalistic', 'talismanic' and 'voodoo' describe practices and objects, with at most a stray use for a person.

heads.title: Spell
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Sorcerer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Churchdom
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives ('priestly', 'clerical', 'monkish', 'papal', 'Popish', 'Roman') can describe a clergy member or believer, though most describe church institutions.

heads.title: Clergy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Ordained', 'in orders' and 'called to the ministry' describe a person's clerical status, while the titles are forms of address.

heads.title: Laity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Lay', 'laical' and 'secular' describe a person's non-clerical status, though 'temporal' and 'civil' describe things.

heads.title: Rite
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe rites and ceremonies, not a person's character.

heads.title: Canonicals
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Temple
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: 'Monastic' and 'cloistered' can describe a person's way of life, while the rest describe buildings or institutions.
